paragraphs: Acapela Group sells text-to-speech software that turns written service information into spoken announcements. The transport work spans rail, urban transport, airports and automotive systems.

Voices are tuned for train stations, bus stops, metro and tram systems, and pronunciation can be corrected in a lexicon editor. Deployment can be in the cloud, embedded in a device, or hybrid, on Linux, Android, iOS and Windows. A server edition speech-enables telecommunications applications and server-based services in real time. Development kits are sold per platform, including one for Linux applications.

The transport page shows a custom voice built for BVG, the Berlin public transport operator. Another sample is a custom voice for Transport for London. The company states GDPR compliance and offers on-device or offline processing.
